summary: Iteration 4, frontend only (web preview, 375x667). The mic was faked by replacing getUserMedia with an OscillatorNode MediaStream. BUG 1 (stale auto-next) is FIXED. In 3 trials (visual->degree twice, visual->listen once), a correct answer was followed by a mode switch within about 0.3s. Each time, 2.5s later the question still belonged to the new mode: degree prompts 'Joue la tierce (3) de' C#maj7 and 'Joue la septième (b7) de' E9, listen prompt 'Écoute et rejoue...' with target '?'. BUG 2 (reveal scoring) is FIXED. Before reveal: score 4, streak 4. After reveal: streak 0, question-answer shown, note-hint-card shown. Playing the revealed note C#3 gave feedback 'Bonne note ! (réponse révélée, pas de point)', with score still 4 and streak still 0. The next question (G4) followed and the feedback was cleared. DESIGN is FIXED. For target C5, the hint positions are s0-f8, s1-f13 and s2-f17. All are <= 17 and all match the target midi. The mini fretboard shows frets 0-17 and is readable. By code review, C#5 gives f9/f14 only. REGRESSION passes (target B4): wrong C#5 -> 'Tu joues C#5 — essaie encore' plus hint-soon; wrong E5 -> note-hint-card (hint-soon removed) with positions s0-f7, s1-f12, s2-f16; B3 -> 'Bonne note, mauvaise octave (B3) — vise 1 octave plus haut'; exact B4 -> 'Bravo ! Bonne note' and score 4->5. No page errors.

issues: Minor: when lastFret=17, the dot for fret 17 and the fret-number row touch the right edge of the card, and a partial '18' label is clipped. It is still readable. Optionally add a little right padding or end the board at lastFret.

action_items: Optional: add small right padding to the NoteHint mini fretboard so the last fret dot and label are not clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: next() now clears autoNext and is called with modeRef.current. The mode effect calls next(mode), which also clears the pending timer. This is correct.
onCorrect checks revealedRef: no score or streak increment, and it shows a non-scoring message. reveal() also sets penalizedRef and resets the streak. This is correct.
NoteHint: when pitchClassOnly=false, positions are filtered to fret <= 17. There is a fallback to all positions if none qualify, which cannot happen for the 40-76 range.
iOS speaker routing was not testable on web.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same mic mock as iteration 3: use add_init_script to override getUserMedia with an OscillatorNode, and call window.__setFreq(f) to change pitch. Use 30 Hz as silence. Hold each note about 1s. Wait 2.3s after reveal or listen playback before playing. Use element.screenshot without the quality option, or with type=jpeg.
rca_of_issue: Both previous bugs were verified fixed: modeRef plus clearing autoNext in next(), and a revealedRef guard in onCorrect.
